profile.name: AU Ute Scout
profile.description: Looking Australia-wide for a rarely available second-hand single-cab (or similar) V8 ute with an automatic gearbox — private sale or auction, including vehicles that may need repair, but excluding Statutory Write-Offs. Factory auto single-cab V8s are scarce; some owners have converted manual to auto. Closely related options are included so the hunt stays useful. Weekly availability report.

memory.content: Standing AU ute hunt: automatic gearbox required; engine can be V8 or other. Prefer Nissan Patrol or Toyota Land Cruiser 70/79; other makes OK. Dual cab allowed. Older Holden V8 utes in-spec (Crewman SS, Cross 8, SS Thunder, VU/VY/VZ/VE SS ute) when automatic. Prefer 2011+ when possible; older Holden auto in-spec. Prefer under AUD $30,000. Damaged, repairable, and auction lots OK. Sources: Gumtree, Facebook Marketplace, Carsales, Pickles, Grays, and similar. Report only real live-URL listings. N
Until the user opens Gumtree, Carsales, or Marketplace access, weekday hunts use Pickles and Grays only. Do not contact sellers or send email without an explicit yes.

Auction write-off rule: check write-off / WOVR / statutory write-off status on auction lots. Do not include Statutory Write-Off vehicles. Repairable write-offs remain allowed unless the user changes that.

When Pickles or Grays show Salvage but write-off codes are locked or Statutory vs Repairable is unclear, do not lead with that lot; only include when Repairable or clean is confirmed, and never include Statutory Write-Off.
Pickles auction catalogue loads and searches normally in desktop Chrome for this workflow (no Cloudflare or captcha block observed).
